prBodyNotes: ### ⚠️ Testing Instructions for Consolidated Monorepo Upgrades
- [ ] Verify that the **Backstage IDP core plugin** still compiles properly.
- [ ] Run `turbo run build` across all sub-packages to check lockfile consistency.
- [ ] Ensure local Dev Mode launches successfully before merging.

**Action Required**: This PR modifies production runtimes. Remember to **increment the version number** in the root `package.json` and release an updated Git tag so downstream consumer repositories pull the updated logic.
